name: B10-0468/2026 – After § 43 – Am 5
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 2026 UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya, Türkiye (COP31)
part_text: 13a. Condemns the exclusion of the Republic of Cyprus, a UN member state, by Türkiye from COP31 preparatory meetings and high-level climate-related events in Antalya; considers such discriminatory practices unacceptable and incompatible with the responsibilities of a country hosting a major UN conference; calls on Türkiye to guarantee the full, equal and unhindered participation of the Republic of Cyprus in all COP31 proceedings and related events, and to refrain from any further attempts to exclude or discriminate against an EU Member State in international multilateral forums dealing with climate issues;
